e601579a-e402-423e-bedf-5a0284e94645.name: Start Generation
e601579a-e402-423e-bedf-5a0284e94645.note:
**Note: You must deploy this flow before running.**

This node allows the flow to be run manually from the designer.  Fill in the correct API ("Application" or "System"), the GraphQL model name, and the screen format (either "table" or "form").

When enabled, the upsertScreen option will create a screen and route for the generated code on the MFGx instance the flow is run in; when disabled, the code can be copied out into a static file.

edf4c241-d703-47a4-acc0-0c53b1d7f692.name: Initialize Context
edf4c241-d703-47a4-acc0-0c53b1d7f692.note: Under the ``` SCREEN_GENERATION_ID ``` you need to set the id of the flow you have created by importing the screen generator.

f763b42d-a30b-4c53-8ab7-d85b9dbfbb5c.name: Fork Props (Table)
f763b42d-a30b-4c53-8ab7-d85b9dbfbb5c.note: Table components have three primary properties that need to be generated: columns (which builds the columns displayed in the table), filters (which builds the filters used to limit the result set), and actions (which builds the buttons in the table's action bar).  These three props are generated separately, then combined together into a single object.

f10047a5-9cd0-46ac-88e1-75077b0670bb.name: Combine (Table Props)
f10047a5-9cd0-46ac-88e1-75077b0670bb.note: This combine pulls together the various props that were generated to build a table.

545627d9-29a5-447b-9512-1950f96f4377.name: Broadcast Components
545627d9-29a5-447b-9512-1950f96f4377.note: A single screen consists of multiple "components", displayed as tabs in the interface.  Each component is generated independently.

61b4cadc-023d-45b9-85ef-2ad4274f383e.name: Route Component Type
61b4cadc-023d-45b9-85ef-2ad4274f383e.note:
There are currently two component types supported by the generator: tables and forms.  Each component type has a different structure, so they're handled by different paths in the flow.

-5/4/2021: Added Data Change Tab as Route Option

112f3870-f1ab-4fef-b4ff-861c1eabf572.name: Combine Components
112f3870-f1ab-4fef-b4ff-861c1eabf572.note: This Combine node pulls together all the components (tabs) that make up a screen definition.

569a4d9b-2894-4b6f-a9f9-a7d7e7a13669.name: Add Component Header Data (Table)
569a4d9b-2894-4b6f-a9f9-a7d7e7a13669.note: Finally, this transform adds header-level data, such as the tab title and component type, to the table definition.

63a642d9-3e05-429e-8404-d9fbf0c6cb5c.name: Construct Query & View (Table)
63a642d9-3e05-429e-8404-d9fbf0c6cb5c.note:
This transform constructs the "query" and "views" properties; these depend on the previous three properties.

11/4/2020: Added Data Changes to the hidden columns

3/22/2021: added id field to $hide

a3636500-9481-496f-9ac3-b74cb272b840.name: Build Actions
a3636500-9481-496f-9ac3-b74cb272b840.note:
12/17/2020 Edited the Linked action response to remove additional ' ' causing a syntax error when unlinking.
12/17/2020 Edited the fields shown on the form for linking to remove the ID.

3ced57aa-366f-4bbf-8302-87c183564cf3.name: Add Component Header Data (Form)
3ced57aa-366f-4bbf-8302-87c183564cf3.note: Finally, this transform adds header-level information, such as the tab title and component type, to the form definition.

5591877f-008d-4199-9df1-42282310ea6c.name: Construct Query & UpdateAction (Form)
5591877f-008d-4199-9df1-42282310ea6c.note:
This transform contructs the "query" and "updateAction" properties, which depend on the generated "sections" and "actions" properties.

- 5/3/2021 Changed form action from Update to Create/Update. This will check if the initialData.id is nil or empty. If this occurs a create mutation will occur. If the initialData.id is not nil or empty the data will be updated. This circumvents the problems with required fields not being passed to an upsert mutation.

b6054b80-611a-4526-8ca5-901816fe4088.name: Fork Props (Form)
b6054b80-611a-4526-8ca5-901816fe4088.note: Similarly, form components have two primary properties that need to be generated: sections (which builds the form sections and inputs displayed in the form) and actions (which builds the buttons in the form's action bar).  These two props are generated separately, then combined together into a single object.

c40d6eb5-e669-4113-ae60-d9b0561c20fa.name: Upsert screen?
c40d6eb5-e669-4113-ae60-d9b0561c20fa.note: When the upsertScreen parameter is set to true, this node routes the flow down a path which will create the screen and route records if they don't exist, or update them if they do.  When that parameter is set to false, the flow execution finishes here, simply returning the generated screen code.
